use_cases.title: Search for homes from the homepage
use_cases.description: A guest starts on the airbnb.co.in homepage, enters a destination in the Where field, optionally supplies valid check-in and check-out dates plus guest counts, clicks Search, and lands on the Homes results page with the submitted parameters preserved; the flow explicitly supports both a complete search with destination, dates, and guests and a partial search with destination and guests only, so the guest can begin browsing even before choosing dates.
use_cases.summary: Start a Homes search from the homepage with inputs preserved.
use_cases.value: Gets the guest from homepage intent capture into browseable Homes results without losing search context.

use_cases.title: Refine home search results
use_cases.description: A guest who has reached the Homes results page can continue narrowing the current search using the existing Filters and Map controls, with results updating after filter application and listings displayed on the map so the guest can refine by both property attributes and location without restarting the search.
use_cases.summary: Refine Homes results with filters and map.
use_cases.value: Helps the guest narrow broad search results into relevant options faster.

use_cases.title: Edit a home search from the results page
use_cases.description: A guest on the Homes results page can see the current destination, dates, and guest parameters in the header, click into those controls to change them, refresh the results without returning to the homepage, and—when the search was started without dates—add dates directly on the results page later instead of restarting the journey.
use_cases.summary: Change search inputs directly from results.
use_cases.value: Lets the guest iterate on a search in place instead of backtracking to the homepage.
